entities.summary: Jerome Louis Simpson is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the Cincinnati Bengals in the second round of the 2008 NFL draft. He also played for the Minnesota Vikings and San Francisco 49ers. Simpson played college football for the Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.
